The '''Penga system''' was located in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Slice" /> the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the [[Transport/Legends|starship]] ''[[Penga Rift]]''.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|19|''Penga Rift''}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Penga [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed it in grid square N-10.<ref name="EAOC" />
